name: Equestrian Festival
about: Spring show season. Sells special festival coats of warmbloods and sport horses (usually 665 SC) and a magical horse.

name: Summer Daze
about: Summer festival where the summer magical horses come back.

name: Camp Western
about: Western-themed event with special Mustang, Saddlebred and Mule coats.

name: Star Stable Birthday
about: Anniversary celebration, sometimes with a free gift horse.

name: Halloween
about: Spooky season. All the Halloween magical horses come back.

name: Winter Village
about: Winter festival. Previous years' winter magical horses come back, plus special winter coats.
